question: Should this PR be held until the Darwin pipe inheritance window is eliminated, or is the residual risk of terminating an unrelated concurrently spawned child acceptable for this release?
rationale: The implementation fixes a serious leak but broadens cleanup to processes holding probe pipes; the remaining Darwin race is outside the helper-local lock and requires an explicit safety decision if it is not repaired.

options.title: Fix Darwin race before merge
options.body: Require an inheritance-safe spawn design and a concurrent unrelated-child regression test before landing the cleanup.

options.title: Accept residual race
options.body: Merge with explicit ownership of the rare risk that an unrelated Darwin child may inherit a probe descriptor and be terminated.

options.title: Narrow cleanup scope
options.body: Pause the broader output-holder termination behavior and land only the resolver and safely bounded cleanup portions.

recommendation.title: Fix Darwin race before merge
recommendation.body: Require an inheritance-safe spawn design and a concurrent unrelated-child regression test before landing the cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the branch hardening fixups and merged the preceding PATH-probe isolation work.
